status.headlineFinding: The previously not-import-ready research risks are now resolved to normalization decisions, protected-area scoping decisions, suppression decisions, or volatile runtime currentness policies. Runtime import remains false only because integration and generated-data edits are out of scope.
doNotImportYetReasons: Runtime app integration was not requested.
Route geometry normalization has not been implemented in normalized route files.
Volatile transit, fire-ban, forestry, business, bathing and shelter-maintenance facts must be rechecked immediately before public runtime display.

scope: Research-only import-risk resolution for Västra Vätterleden candidate data. This file does not integrate anything into runtime app data.
summary: Static research blockers resolved for candidate normalization. See import-readiness-resolution.research.json for the final route, protected-area, transit and volatile-data decisions.

sourcesConsulted.title: Existing section research files for sections 1-8
Mullsjö kommun planbeskrivning Torestorp 1:300
sourcesConsulted.notes: The municipal planning document says Västra Vätterleden crosses the planning area and will be rerouted so it continues north and west. This corroborates later field-report evidence that the final approach into Mullsjö changed, but it does not by itself define the current import geometry.

sourcesConsulted.title: Naturkartan: Eldstad Hjoåns dalgång
sourcesConsulted.notes: Naturkartan/Västra Götaland exposes a mapped fire/rest object in Hjoåns dalgång. This conflicts with reserve-rule evidence recorded in the stage 4 and 5 research files that prohibits fire in the reserve unless an exception or outside-boundary placement is proven.

sourcesConsulted.title: Skaraborgsleder/Västsverige: Västra Vätterleden Etapp 1 PDF
sourcesConsulted.notes: The PDF revision checked in this pass labels stage 1 as 31 km and describes multiple official alternative legs around Stora Djäknasjön/Granvik and Kalvöåsen/Källebacken.

sourcesConsulted.notes: The section research recorded this GPX as updated 2025-07-09. It is useful as a cross-check but should not override current official Naturkartan geometry without a normalization decision.

sourcesConsulted.title: Sveriges nationalparker: Tiveden National Park
usedFor: Stage 1 Tiveden National Park scope caveat
sourcesConsulted.notes: Used with the stage 1 route/source packet to narrow, not eliminate, the national-park scoping risk. The final import still needs a boundary overlay if a connector enters the park.

geometryChecks.method: Fetched the current Naturkartan VV8 Furusjö-Mullsjö Hotell GPX and E1 10.08 GPX, reversed Naturkartan to official Furusjö-to-Mullsjö order, sliced the E1 track from the nearest Furusjö point, then compared endpoint gaps and nearest-point distances.

naturkartanStoredDirection.direction: Hotel Mullsjö to Furusjö; reverse for official planning order

geometryChecks.interpretation: Current Naturkartan and E1/OSM geometry are materially the same in the final Furusjö-Mullsjö corridor. The remaining risk is endpoint/trailhead selection around Hotel Mullsjö, not a stale full-route geometry problem.

resolvedRisks.previousRisk: A July 2025 field report said the last kilometres into Mullsjö had been rerouted and shortened, raising concern that the current official split GPX might be stale.
resolvedRisks.finding: The reroute signal is real enough to preserve as history/currentness context, but the current official Naturkartan split GPX and E1/OSM linework now match closely through the final Furusjö-Mullsjö corridor. The only material difference is the Hotel Mullsjö endpoint/trailhead point, about 155 m apart.
resolvedRisks.normalizationDecision: Use the current official Naturkartan/Smålandsleden split GPX as primary geometry. Reverse the Furusjö-Mullsjö Hotell GPX for planning order and use 57.903080,13.872020 as the official Hotel Mullsjö endpoint unless a maintainer later states otherwise. Retain OSM/E1 endpoint about 57.9042,13.8706 as an alternate trailhead/access cross-check, not as an import blocker.
resolvedRisks.runtimeImportHandling: No extra field-source research is required before candidate normalization. Recheck official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan geometry immediately before runtime import if the import is delayed.

resolvedRisks.previousRisk: Official overview material treats stage 8 as one stage, while current Smålandsleden/Naturkartan source material exposes two route pages and two GPX files.
resolvedRisks.finding: This is a data-model issue, not a research blocker.
resolvedRisks.normalizationDecision: Keep one official section id and stage number for Etapp 8, with two official child geometry components: Gagnån/Fagerhult-Furusjö and Furusjö-Hotel Mullsjö. Keep the Fagerhult access connector and Hotel Mullsjö-Mullsjö centrum connector separate from the mainline.
resolvedRisks.runtimeImportHandling: Import logic should preserve one user-facing official section while allowing component geometries.

resolvedRisks.previousRisk: Fagerhult is the named access endpoint, but the continuous stage 7/8 trail handoff occurs at Gagnån.
resolvedRisks.finding: The continuous mainline handoff is Gagnån around 58.002709,14.104708. Fagerhult village/start area is an access connector, not the mainline continuity point.
resolvedRisks.normalizationDecision: Model stage 7 mainline to Gagnån, stage 8 mainline from Gagnån, and the Fagerhult connector as access geometry used for transit/trailhead display.
resolvedRisks.runtimeImportHandling: Avoid snapping the continuous mainline to Fagerhult village; use Fagerhult as access metadata.

resolvedRisks.previousRisk: Nearby protected-area search hits could accidentally attach unrelated rules to stage 8.
resolvedRisks.finding: Gagnån naturreservat/Natura 2000 is directly route-relevant at the stage 7/8 handoff. Södra Kroksjön should be treated as a service/facility point, not a confirmed protected area. Ryfors gammelskog and Stråkens strandskogar are near the broader Mullsjö/Stråken context but should not attach to stage 8 without geometry overlap.
resolvedRisks.normalizationDecision: Apply Gagnån rules to the route area that overlaps Gagnån after boundary overlay. Do not attach Södra Kroksjön, Ryfors or Stråken protected-area rules without exact route/access overlap.
resolvedRisks.runtimeImportHandling: Still requires boundary overlay before runtime rule attribution.

resolvedRisks.previousRisk: Stage 1 starts at Stenkällegården near Tiveden National Park; blanket-applying national park rules to the section could be wrong.
resolvedRisks.finding: Stenkällegården is adjacent to, not automatically inside all relevant national-park rule scope for the stage. The stage should not inherit Tiveden National Park restrictions unless the normalized line or a modeled connector actually enters the park boundary.
resolvedRisks.normalizationDecision: Do not attach Tiveden National Park rules section-wide. Apply national-park rules only to route/access geometry proved by boundary overlay to enter the park.
resolvedRisks.runtimeImportHandling: Boundary overlay still required if the Stenkällegården connector or chosen stage-1 variant touches the park.

resolvedRisks.previousRisk: Some tourism/operator wording could cause Hökensås to be mislabeled as a national park or otherwise over-scoped.
resolvedRisks.finding: The correct legal label for Hökensås in this packet is naturvårdsområde, with Hyltan naturreservat also relevant around Vitsjön/Hyltesjön.
resolvedRisks.normalizationDecision: Model Hökensås as naturvårdsområde. Do not call it a national park.
resolvedRisks.runtimeImportHandling: Use the formal protected-area class in rule display after overlay.

resolvedRisks.previousRisk: Naturkartan maps an Hjoåns dalgång firepoint, but reserve rules in the section research prohibit fire.
resolvedRisks.finding: The mapped Naturkartan firepoint is real, but no public source in this pass proved that it is a legal exception to the Hjoåns dalgång no-fire rule or outside the restricted boundary.
resolvedRisks.normalizationDecision: Do not import the Hjoåns dalgång firepoint as a usable public fireplace. Keep it suppressed or pending until boundary overlay or an official exception confirms it is legally usable.
resolvedRisks.runtimeImportHandling: If retained in candidate data, mark as pending legality verification rather than importable.

resolvedRisks.previousRisk: OSM/wiki labels truncate or shift section names and endpoints.
resolvedRisks.finding: Official/Naturkartan/KML endpoints and section labels are stronger than OSM/wiki labels for these sections.
resolvedRisks.normalizationDecision: Use official section names and endpoint coordinates from the section research; use OSM only as a geometry cross-check after endpoint correction.
resolvedRisks.runtimeImportHandling: Do not import raw OSM relation names as canonical display names.

resolvedRisks.previousRisk: Many lakes, streams, springs and shelter-side water clues appear in route descriptions and field reports, but reliability and potability vary.
resolvedRisks.finding: Natural water should not be imported as potable water unless a managed, source-backed drinking-water facility is identified. Lakes/streams can remain narrative or safety context with boil/filter caveats.
resolvedRisks.normalizationDecision: Import only managed taps/pumps/service-water points with source-backed coordinates and access caveats. Keep springs and natural water pending unless verified.
resolvedRisks.runtimeImportHandling: Recheck water currentness before display where water access is user-facing.

partiallyResolvedRisks.finding: Current official display distance is 31 km. The direct south route aligns better with 31 km, while Källebacken is an official alternate/variant. The north branch still has two official choices via Djäknatorp or Djäknasundet.
partiallyResolvedRisks.remainingDecision: No research decision remains. Implement the documented primary/direct-south plus alternate-variant model during geometry normalization.
partiallyResolvedRisks.recommendedHandling: Ready for candidate normalization; do not use incomplete full-stage Naturkartan GPX as runtime geometry.

partiallyResolvedRisks.finding: Direct Fröjden-Bygget is the primary continuity route; Skackastugan/Bergsudden is an official shelter-side alternate/branch.
partiallyResolvedRisks.remainingDecision: No research decision remains. Implement direct primary plus Skackastugan alternate during geometry normalization.
partiallyResolvedRisks.recommendedHandling: Ready for candidate normalization; preserve measured direct and alternate lengths as geometry metadata.

partiallyResolvedRisks.finding: Official NVR/Natura 2000 overlay resolves Hållsdammsbäcken as Hökensås NVO context, not Gagnån. Gagnån rules apply to the stage-8 start/Gagnån area.
partiallyResolvedRisks.remainingDecision: No protected-area legality decision remains for Gagnån. Shelter roof/maintenance and local fireplace usability are runtime currentness checks.
partiallyResolvedRisks.recommendedHandling: Import Hållsdammsbäcken as shelter/rest with Hökensås caveats, not as Gagnån no-fire/no-tent context.

partiallyResolvedRisks.finding: Current Västtrafik line 402 confirms Baståsen A/B stop names valid 2025-12-14 to 2026-12-12. Västtrafik says Hjo-Tidaholm line 405 was withdrawn; current line 405 is unrelated Svaneholm-Kinna service.
partiallyResolvedRisks.remainingDecision: Verify exact Baståsen A/B stop-side coordinates and walking connector before coordinate POI import. Do not import old Rödåkra/line 405 as current.
partiallyResolvedRisks.recommendedHandling: Use Baståsen A/B as coordinate-pending transit access evidence; suppress Rödåkra/line 405 as stale unless planner data later confirms a current stop.

partiallyResolvedRisks.finding: Official NVR/Natura 2000 WKT overlay was run against current official route components. Route-relevant areas and nearby-only areas are now documented in import-readiness-resolution.research.json.
partiallyResolvedRisks.remainingDecision: Repeat overlay against final normalized geometries if geometry changes before runtime import.
partiallyResolvedRisks.recommendedHandling: Ready for candidate normalization; attach rules only to proven overlapping route/access geometry.

unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.reason: Skogsstyrelsen avverkningsanmälningar are currentness/impact data, not durable static trail facts.
unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.handling: Run exact Skogsstyrelsen polygon-to-final-route-buffer overlay after route normalization and before making public closure/impact claims.

unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.reason: Current stop/line evidence is recorded, including Baståsen A/B line 402 and the withdrawal of old line 405, but departures and prebooking rules remain volatile.
unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.handling: Recheck Västtrafik/JLT/Resrobot planner data immediately before runtime display.

unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.reason: Municipal fire bans and fire-risk alerts are same-day currentness data, separate from reserve-specific standing rules.
unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.handling: Do not hard-code same-day fire-ban state from 2026-04-29 research. Recheck official fire-ban sources before display.

unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.reason: Campsites, shops, restaurants, lodging and sport-fishing services are seasonal or commercial and may change.
unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.handling: Import only first-party/current services with coordinates and opening/access caveats.

unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.reason: Bathing-water quality and algal bloom notices are date-specific.
unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.handling: Recheck HaV/municipal bathing data before exposing swimming quality/status.

unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.reason: Some shelter records have currentness caveats, including Hållsdammsbäcken roof condition and Hornsjön newer-shelter status.
unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.handling: Verify shelter maintenance/status before importing overnight-shelter details as user-facing facts.

unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.reason: Several off-route/town services near endpoints are useful but not core trail facilities.
unresolvedOrRuntimeOnlyRisks.handling: Decide app scope for optional services before spending more coordinate verification effort.

recommendedNormalizationPlan.name: Normalize route geometry first
recommendedNormalizationPlan.details: Resolve stage 1 variants, stage 2 branches, stages 3-5 segment assembly/reversal, stage 7 mainline/access split and stage 8 two child GPX components plus connectors.

recommendedNormalizationPlan.name: Apply protected-area rule scoping after geometry
recommendedNormalizationPlan.details: Run boundary overlays before attaching Tiveden, Granvik/Håketjärnarna, Stora Röå/Röå alsumpskog, Hjoåns dalgång, Hökensås/Hyltan, Gagnån or Mullsjö/Stråken area rules.

recommendedNormalizationPlan.name: Import only high-confidence facilities
recommendedNormalizationPlan.details: Import facilities with source-backed coordinates and clear legal/currentness status. Keep Hjoåns dalgång fireplace, Hållsdammsbäcken fireplace/camping, Rödåkra/line 405, natural water, optional businesses and unverified subfacilities pending or suppressed.

recommendedNormalizationPlan.name: Recheck volatile sources immediately before runtime import
recommendedNormalizationPlan.details: Transit schedules, fire bans, SMHI fire risk, forestry notices, business hours, bathing-water status, water reliability and shelter maintenance should be checked near the actual import date.

nextSafeStep: Proceed only with a candidate normalization implementation pass under data/research/candidate-trails/vastra-vatterleden/ if explicitly requested. Do not integrate runtime app data yet.
notesForFutureThreads: This file intentionally resolves research risk, not app import policy.
Stage 8 reroute risk is no longer a blocker for candidate normalization; preserve endpoint discrepancy as a local trailhead/access decision.
Stage 1 and stage 2 still need explicit branch/alternate modeling decisions.
Hjoåns dalgång firepoint should be treated as suppress-or-pending, not importable fireplace.
Natural water should not become potable-water POIs without managed-source evidence.
